A '''''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle''' was stolen from [[Count Dooku's frigate/Legends|Count Dooku's frigate]] by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] during a [[Skirmish at Vanqor/Legends|skirmish]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Skywalker and Kenobi used it to pursue [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]], where both parties crash-landed.
